Patrick K. Githendu, Director (66)
Joined the board in 2017 having served in the Board of Co-optrust Investment Services Ltd
since 1998 and the Board of Co-op Consultancy & Insurance Agency Ltd since 2009. He is a
businessman, with vast experience particularly in the coffee industry. He is the Vice Chairman
of Co-opholdings Co-operative Society Limited and Director of Kingdom Securities Limited.
He is a Director in Kenya Co-operative Coffee Exporters (KCCE).
